I met Tanaka-san, but not Yamada-san.
items.target: たなかさんには あいましたが、やまださんには あいませんでした。
items.note: Contrast with a particle other than が or を: the particle stays and は is added after it, so たなかさんに becomes たなかさんには (Tanaka-san ni wa). が and を are replaced by は instead, as in ワインは のみますが (wain wa nomimasu ga).
items.reviewNote: The book's own GRAMMAR 3 example. Added after the chapter-mode final review: the chapter teaches は for contrast with two sub-rules, and only the が/を one had a card.
